Stable DNS does not establish arbitrary delayed full-fleet restart safety. With old member lease expiry plus max(3*TTL,20s) elapsed, a failed seal request is conclusive; no complete witness permits permanent loss declaration. The 10-second HTTP timeout is a maximum, not a minimum wait.
Recovery gathers reachable follower disks and bucket bundles; the retained local writer image is not an independent predecessor recovery witness.
Public docs require retaining node names, peer addresses, data directories but do not clearly disclose bounded-loss exception; no claim of slow-attach, arbitrary-lag or cross-host recovery safety.
